injuries.name: Jordan Leasure
injuries.note: The White Sox traded Leasure to the Phillies on Friday in exchange for minor-league right-hander Christian Coppola.

injuries.name: Bryan Rincon
injuries.note: Rincon underwent hamstring surgery shortly after the conclusion of the minor-league season, Matt Gelb of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Brandon Marsh
injuries.note: Marsh underwent surgery after the season on his left hand, just above the wrist, Matt Gelb of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Johan Rojas
injuries.note: The Phillies reinstated Rojas (elbow) from the restricted list Thursday and placed him on the 60-day injured list.

injuries.name: Felix Reyes
injuries.note: The Phillies recalled Reyes from Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Thursday and placed him on the 60-day injured list with a right wrist fracture.

injuries.name: Brad Keller
injuries.note: Keller underwent right elbow UCL reconstruction surgery with internal brace and flexor tendon repair Tuesday, Lochlahn March of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.
